With a pedal-assist motor to supercharge your ride, our ebikes are the easiest way to get around the metro DC area. Pricing starts at $1 to unlock plus $0.35/minute.

inputs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, COUNT(DISTINCT scenario_account_id) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='electric_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' THEN billable_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS classic_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='electric_bike' THEN billable_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' THEN MAX(billable_minutes-45,0) ELSE 0 END) AS classic_overage_minutes FROM trips

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, COUNT(DISTINCT scenario_account_id) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='electric_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' THEN billable_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS classic_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='electric_bike' THEN billable_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type='classic_bike' THEN MAX(billable_minutes-45,0) ELSE 0 END) AS classic_overage_minutes FROM trips

break_even.method: Per account: membership fee / sample-average (casual ride cost minus member residual). Ceiling gives weak break-even; ties recommend Pay Per Ride/Minute. The strict threshold is floor + 1. Minutes use sample-average billed minutes. This repeated sample-mix approximation is not a guarantee for every ordering of heterogeneous rides.

assumptions: hypothetical assigned account; not observed rider history
Each scenario account purchases its own 30-day membership at coverage_start; fees cannot be shared between accounts.
The coverage end is exclusive for trip starts; every trip must finish within coverage.
Offset-free trip timestamps are interpreted in America/New_York local time; no observed rider identity is inferred.
Pre-tax base transportation comparison: location-dependent sales taxes are excluded.
Parking, damages, lost-bike and other penalties are excluded because the trip CSV does not observe them; ebike totals include transportation only.
Current captured prices are applied counterfactually to the uploaded trip durations.
The entire membership fee is allocated to the calendar week containing coverage_start; later weeks include only residual charges.
Original member_casual describes the public source trip and is not a scenario identity or the product selected for this counterfactual comparison.
A tie recommends Pay Per Ride/Minute; comparison savings are pay-per-use minus membership total.
result.justification: Pay per use costs $1602.65 for 500 rides across 10 hypothetical accounts [2]. The membership alternative totals $255.85 including ride charges for 10 separate accounts [3]. Each account pays $25 for a 30-day membership with 45 included classic minutes per ride and $0.05 per extra minute [3]. Ride minutes are rounded up separately for every ride [3]. Buy Monthly Membership is the recommendation for this assumed 30-day cohort [2][3].
